title: Health check
description: What keeps a mod from loading, and the fixes the panel can make for you.
loadFailed: The health check could not run.
reloadFailed: Checking again failed; this is the last result.
emptyDesc: Every enabled mod is installed, its requirements are met and the load order follows its rules.
noPermission: Your role does not have permission to manage mods.

entryIssue.emptyEntry: empty (two commas in a row, or nothing after require=)
entryIssue.whitespace: padded with spaces, which the game does not trim
entryIssue.semicolon: separated with “;” instead of a comma
entryIssue.unknown: not something the game can read

requireLoop.title: Required mods form a loop
requireLoop.body: {{mods}} require each other in a circle. The server crashes while loading them. Remove one of them, or ask its author to fix its mod.info.

modInfoBroken.title: A broken require= line in mod.info
modInfoBroken.body: In the mod.info of {{mod}}, the require= entry “{{entry}}” is {{problem}}. The game cannot read it and skips {{mod}}.
modInfoBroken.affected: Also skipped, because they need it: {{mods}}.
modInfoBroken.hint: Only the mod's author can fix its mod.info. Until then, keep the mod off or remove it.

requiredNotInstalled.title: A required mod is not installed
requiredNotInstalled.body: {{missing}} is required by {{requiredBy}}, but no installed Workshop item ships it. The game skips {{affected}}.
requiredNotInstalled.caseMatch: An installed mod is called {{match}}: the ID differs only in upper or lower case, and the game needs an exact match.
requiredNotInstalled.b41Only: {{missing}} exists only as a Build 41 mod (Workshop item {{item}}), so it never loads on Build 42.

requiredWorkshopItemMissing.title: A required Workshop item is missing
requiredWorkshopItemMissing.body: {{target}} is listed under Required items on Steam by {{items}}, but it is not in WorkshopItems=.
requiredWorkshopItemMissing.downloaded: It is already downloaded on this server.
requiredWorkshopItemMissing.notDownloaded: Once it is added, the server downloads it on its next start.

notInstalled.title: A mod in the list is not installed
notInstalled.body: {{mod}} is in Mods=, but no Workshop item in WorkshopItems= ships it, so the game skips it.
notInstalled.foundIn: Workshop item {{item}}, already on disk, ships it: add that item.
notInstalled.notDownloaded_one: {{count}} Workshop item is not downloaded yet and may ship it: start the server once to download it.
notInstalled.notDownloaded_other: {{count}} Workshop items are not downloaded yet and may ship it: start the server once to download them.

b41Only.title: A Build 41 mod is in the list
b41Only.body: {{mod}} (Workshop item {{item}}) has no Build 42 version, so the game never loads it on this server.

incompatibleEnabled.title: Two incompatible mods are both enabled
incompatibleEnabled.body: {{a}} and {{b}} both load, but the mod.info of {{declaredBy}} says they do not work together. Keep only one of them.

duplicateModId.title: The same mods are installed twice

mapNotInMapLine.title: A map is missing from Map=
mapNotInMapLine.body: {{mod}} ships the map {{folders}}, but Map= does not list it, so it never appears in the world.

mapFolderWithoutMod.title: Map= names a map no enabled mod ships
mapFolderWithoutMod.body: Map= lists {{folder}}, but no loaded mod provides it.
mapFolderWithoutMod.shippedBy: {{items}} has it: enable its mod, or take the folder out of Map=.
mapFolderWithoutMod.nobody: No installed Workshop item has it either.

orderProblems.title: The load order breaks some of its rules
orderProblems.changesLoading_one: Smart sort would move {{count}} mod for a requirement, a pinned rule or a group. The game does not load it the way its rules ask.
orderProblems.changesLoading_other: Smart sort would move {{count}} mods for a requirement, a pinned rule or a group. The game does not load them the way their rules ask.
orderProblems.tidyOnly_one: Smart sort would move {{count}} mod for its rules. The game already loads it correctly, so this only tidies the list.
orderProblems.tidyOnly_other: Smart sort would move {{count}} mods for their rules. The game already loads them correctly, so this only tidies the list.

requiredLoadedImplicitly.title: A required mod is not in the list
requiredLoadedImplicitly.body: {{mod}} is required by {{requiredBy}} but not listed in Mods=. The game loads it first anyway; adding it makes the order visible and editable.

unusedWorkshopItem.title: A Workshop item is not used
unusedWorkshopItem.body: {{item}} is in WorkshopItems=, but none of its mods ({{mods}}) is enabled and none of its maps is in Map=. The server still downloads and updates it.

updatesAvailable.title: Mod updates are available
updatesAvailable.body_one: {{count}} Workshop item has an update. Restart the server to install it; players get it when they join.
updatesAvailable.body_other: {{count}} Workshop items have updates. Restart the server to install them; players get them when they join.

duplicates.pair: 2 Workshop items ship the same mods ({{mods}}): {{items}}. The server loads only one copy of each, and which one isn't defined. Keep one of the two items.
duplicates.many: Several Workshop items ship the same mods ({{mods}}): {{items}}. The server loads only one copy of each, and which one isn't defined. Keep one of them.
duplicates.defined: More than one copy of {{mods}} is installed. The server loads the one from {{from}} and ignores the others.
duplicates.local: The server's mods folder has more than one copy of {{mods}}. The server loads only one, and which one isn't defined. Keep one copy.
duplicates.confirmKeep: {{item}} stays. A backup of the server ini is made, then this is removed from it:
duplicates.removedRepeat: From Mods=: the extra entry of {{mod}}

confirm.title: Are you absolutely sure?
confirm.removeMods: These mods are taken out of Mods= in the server ini. Their Workshop items stay installed, and a backup of the ini is made first.
confirm.removeWorkshopItems: These Workshop items are taken out of WorkshopItems=: the server stops downloading and updating them. A backup of the ini is made first.
confirm.removeMapFolders: These map folders are taken out of Map= in the server ini. A backup of the ini is made first.

fixAll.noneReason: None of these problems has a fix that only adds to the mod list.
fixAll.confirmDesc: These fixes only add to the server ini or apply the suggested load order: nothing is removed. They run one by one and stop at the first error.
fixAll.stoppedTitle: Stopped at a fix that failed

toast.unchangedDesc: The server ini already matched this fix.
toast.failedTitle: The fix could not be applied
toast.failedFallback: The server did not apply the fix.
toast.goneDesc: The mod list was checked again.

summary.critical_one: {{count}} problem will stop mods from loading
summary.critical_other: {{count}} problems will stop mods from loading
